# system.registerWizard

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--new">since 26.2.0</span></div>

Register a model category in the model wizard, shown on its first page with the built-in model types (Plane, Glider...). When it is chosen, the wizard shows its pages, then the model name page. Its models are of the "Other" type.

```lua
system.registerWizard(name, icon, pages)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string or function | yes | category name |
| `icon` | mask | yes | category icon (lcd.loadMask()) |
| `pages` | table | yes | the category pages, in their display order, in the same format as system.registerWizardPage() (`index` is ignored) |

## Returns

Nothing.

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
local icon = lcd.loadMask("icon.png")
system.registerWizard("Tank", icon, {
  {build=buildTracksPage, run=createTracksMixes},
  {available=hasTurret, build=buildTurretPage, run=createTurretMixes},
})
```
